headword: {国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}
reading: こくみんけんこうほけん

definitions.explanation: Japan's public health insurance program for residents who are not covered by employer-based insurance. Administered by municipal governments and mandatory for all eligible residents, including self-employed workers, students, and retirees.

examples.japanese: {国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}に{加入|かにゅう}した。
examples.english: I enrolled in National Health Insurance.

examples.japanese: {退職|たいしょく}したら{会社|かいしゃ}の{保険|ほけん}から{国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}に{切|き}り{替|か}える{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: When you leave your job, you need to switch from company insurance to National Health Insurance.

examples.japanese: {国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}の{保険料|ほけんりょう}は{前年|ぜんねん}の{所得|しょとく}に{基|もと}づいて{計算|けいさん}されるため、{収入|しゅうにゅう}が{多|おお}いと{負担|ふたん}も{大|おお}きくなる。
examples.english: National Health Insurance premiums are calculated based on the previous year's income, so the burden increases with higher earnings.

notes:
Composed of {国民|こくみん} (citizens, nationals), {健康|けんこう} (health), and {保険|ほけん} (insurance). Almost always abbreviated to {国保|こくほ} in everyday speech and written communication. An essential term for anyone living in Japan, as all residents must be enrolled in some form of health insurance.

USAGE:
Japan's universal healthcare system has two main pillars: employer-based insurance ({社会保険|しゃかいほけん} or {社保|しゃほ}) and National Health Insurance ({国保|こくほ}). The latter covers the self-employed, part-time workers not eligible for employer plans, students, and those between jobs. Foreign residents in Japan are also required to enroll.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}に{加入|かにゅう}する: to enroll in NHI
- {国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}{料|りょう}: NHI premiums
- {国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}{証|しょう}: NHI card
- {国保|こくほ}に{切|き}り{替|か}える: to switch to NHI

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国保|こくほ}: NHI (abbreviation) — the standard short form used in everyday speech
- {社会保険|しゃかいほけん}: social insurance — employer-based health and pension insurance
- {健康保険|けんこうほけん}: health insurance — can refer to any health insurance, but often specifically means employer-based health insurance
- {後期高齢者医療制度|こうきこうれいしゃいりょうせいど}: late-stage elderly medical care system — the insurance system for those aged 75 and over
